newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade active.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade active.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were stable in late trading on Friday, with buying interest picking up following increases in Malaysia, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,450-55 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but trades were also heard at 1,440-45 rupiah. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,271 rupiah/kg in the North Sumatran city of Medan on Thursday.
"The market became active after prices started going up in Malaysia," one trader said. "It was a welcome change since the market has been rather lethargic recently."
The traders said players were being cautious during the ongoing run-up to the general election on May 29, preferring to keep stock levels just sufficient in case of any social unrest.
They said they expected palm olein prices to be generally stable next week.

Meanwhile, data from Belawan Port showed that the MV MCC-Vantage will leave the North Sumatran port on Saturday for Turkey with 10,000 tonnes of palm oil. The MT Sun-Saphire will also leave on Saturday for Malaysia with 8,100 tonne of crude palm oil. The MV Canal will leave for Port Klang, Malaysia with 5,900 tonnes of palm kernel expeller on Saturday.
